dimensions.description: Uses Slice Plan only through its declared Carve consumer and keeps the private dependency inactive for ambient user planning requests.

evals.name: carve-consumer-load
evals.prompt: Carve loads slice-plan by canonical name to decompose settled requirements.
evals.expected_output: The host records the declared Slice Plan dependency load.
expectations: Slice Plan loads by canonical name for Carve.

evals.name: ambient-decomposition-request
evals.prompt: Break these requirements into a few implementation tasks.
evals.expected_output: Slice Plan stays inactive because it is a private dependency and Carve was not canonically invoked.
expectations: The host records no Slice Plan selection or load.
